title: Cap-Table Extraction-Only Sentinel
description: Marker file written by compose_extraction_report.py to indicate that the cap-table skill ran in extraction-only mode (instrument terms rendered from inputs.json + instruments.json only; no equity base was supplied, so no ownership/dilution math and no canonical JSON artifacts were produced). Cross-skill consumers reading a {company_slug}-extraction REVIEW_DIR should check for this file before treating a missing report.json as 'never ran'.

schema_version.description: Sentinel schema version. Distinct from the main cap-table report schema (v0.5.0-cap-table) and the fast-assess sentinel (v0.1.0-cap-table-fast-assess).

run_id.description: Run identifier (ISO-8601 timestamp with separators stripped). Unique per extraction-only invocation.

company_slug.description: Kebab-case slug derived from company_name. The REVIEW_DIR is conventionally `cap-table-{company_slug}-extraction/`.

rule_pack_version.description: Version of cap-table-rules.json in effect when the sentinel was written. Lets consumers detect rule-pack drift since the sentinel was written.

produces_canonical_artifacts.description: Always false in extraction-only mode. Marker that no cap_state.json / scenarios.json / rule_audit.json / counsel_packet.json / report.json was produced.

note.description: Human-readable explanation of the extraction-only contract.

extraction_report_path.description: Absolute path to the founder-facing markdown report (`report_extraction_only.md`).

instruments_summary.description: Counts of financing instruments found in instruments.json.

rerun_hint.description: Human-readable instruction for getting full artifacts once an equity base is supplied.
